titleEn: Merchant MCP read tools (store, orders, products, customers, analytics, funnel, coupons, reviews)
mcpTool: admin_get_store; admin_list_orders; admin_get_order; admin_list_products; admin_get_product; admin_list_customers; admin_get_customer; admin_get_analytics; admin_get_funnel; admin_list_coupons; admin_list_reviews

en: Can Claude read my store data?
Which MCP keys exist on my store?

steps: Mint key then connect an MCP client.
edgeCases: Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Plan/feature not allowing it: API returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with an upgrade target when the plan is the cause; assistant must name the plan and link Billing, never imply a toggle
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: Read tools cover only 11 entities: no shipping, finance, inventory list, staff, settings reads (assistant needs the full capability set, not MCP)

readOnlyPost.reason: JSON-RPC transport; this entry covers only the 11 admin_get/list read tools, which never write; the write tools and the write switch belong to integrations.merchant-mcp
